description:
Rich and Performant, Cross Platform Java Library(100% Java).No native dependencies. 
        ParserNG is the height of interpreted Math parsing in Java. It is the fastest of all interpreted Java math parsers.
        Version 1.2.0 introduces full Matrix Algebra to the Standard Mode allowing the user(howbeit at a slower speed and less memory efficiency than turbo)
        It also optimizes the evaluation of power operators in the Standard mode, by using more efficient paths for common powers
